name: io.github.tlefko/central-command
title: Central Command
description: Pay-per-use crypto trading MCP: market-intel packs, sanitized fade signals, funding/liquidations, backtests, AI agent strategy console, and position sizing via x402 micropayments on Base USDC. Free tier available with linked Connect keys.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Optional prepaid key from POST /x402-gateway/register (or Tasks → Connect). Omit for pure x402 pay-per-use.

headers.name: X-PAYMENT
headers.description: Optional x402 payment proof (retry after 402 accepts). Also accepted as tool arg __x_payment.
